evidenceClasses.fixture: Deterministic local story, unit, or component evidence without the native desktop/gateway boundary.
evidenceClasses.native-gateway: A real Tauri window driven through the Rust host, transport-rust, and the controlled Kannel stack.
evidenceClasses.packaged-manual: A packaged application check that depends on platform integration or assistive technology.
